newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Group profits up for quarter and year.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Group profits up for quarter and year.

text.p: Travelers Group said Tuesday that its profits rose 6 percent in the fourth quarter and 27 percent for the full year, propelled by the strong performances of its brokerage and insurance divisions.
The giant insurance and financial services company said its net income for the three months ended Dec. 31 rose to $643.3 million, or 97 cents a share, from $606.9 million, or 92 cents a share.
For the full year, New York-based Travelers said its net income climbed to $2.33 billion, or $3.50 a share, from $1.83 billion, or $2.76 a share.
The company said total revenues for the quarter rose to $5.78 billion from $4.26 billion while revenues for all of 1996 grew to $21.35 billion from $17.62 billion.
Travelers said its fourth-quarter operating earnings soared 38 percent to a record $608.5 million, or 92 cents a share, from $441.7 million, or 66 cents a share.
For the full year, operating earnings grew 37 percent to a record $2.23 billion, or $3.35 a share, from $1.63 billion, or $2.44 a share.
The company said per-share figures reflect two stock splits last year and the repurchase of about 17.3 million common shares.
Travelers said its Smith Barney brokerage unit contributed $226.4 million to fourth-quarter operating earnings and a record $888.8 million to the full year's operating earnings.
The company said Smith Barney posted the second-highest quarterly earnings in its history and record earnings for the year.
It added that Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp., in which the company has an 82 percent interest, almost doubled its operating earnings to $214.5 million in the quarter.
For the year, the unit, formed after Travelers' acquisition of Aetna's property casualty operations in April 1996, increased operating earnings by 68 percent to $691.5 million.
The company also said its Travelers Life and Annuity and Primerica Financial Services units also achieved record operating earnings for both the quarter and the year.
